claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified now, based on aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, with the field-service dispatch subgroup regression handled through caveated documentation rather than resolved mitigation or approved risk acceptance.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if the material field-service dispatch weakness is disclosed in current documentation or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support readiness but do not waive the disclosure/mitigation requirement.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidentiary support.
evidence_requests: Current release documentation showing the field-service dispatch limitation is explicitly disclosed as a named launch-use-case limitation.
Approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation documentation, if the team intends to rely on mitigation instead of disclosure.
The final model-card or certification packet reflecting current evaluation results, including the subgroup regression.
Any approval record showing a reviewer accepted launch with this exact retrieval configuration and current eval batch.
specific_concerns: The policy predicate for certification is not fully satisfied on the current record: material segment weaknesses must be disclosed in current release documentation or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
The admissible evidence shows a current material subgroup weakness in the field-service dispatch slice.
No admissible evidence shows attached disclosure language in the current release documentation.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation for the subgroup regression.
Prior approval predates the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot support current-release certification by itself.
The informal monitoring comment is operational context only and does not satisfy the policy requirement for reviewed mitigation or approved acceptance.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently compliant on the existing record.
That prior approval or the monitoring comment materially closes the current policy gap.
That the required current-release disclosure has already been made.
